user_constraint: Body and legs must be painted and designed as one whole moving person; no independently generated legs assembled onto a torso.

forbidden: mirroring the same leading leg to fake a full stride
increasing interpolation count to hide incorrect poses
body_production.extra_drawings: Add actual whole-body breakdowns at crossings, weight changes and silhouette changes when needed; do not fabricate independent limb motion.
body_production.weapon_policy: Design blade/grip/body together; derive independent weapon and grip-occlusion layers only after the intact pose is established, preserving free weapon switching.

review_order: Whole-body key poses at the accepted head/body scale; inspect hips, knees, feet, shoulders and weight support together
Complete left/right stride at real speed with coherent mass transfer, arm and coat response; inspect bare body before effects
Slow playback checks for silhouette continuity, crossing legs and source-frame gaps; add drawn breakdowns where needed
Match actual movement speed and foot support; tune duration instead of stretching limbs
Start/stop, instant facing, three weapons and transitions in game using the identical preview export
